mapper.insert: insert into status (id, department_id, status) values (#{id}, #{departmentId}, 0);

insert into recruit_user(student_id, user_name, introduction, major, college, first_intention, second_intention, phone, gender) values (#{student_id}, #{user_name}, #{introduction}, #{major}, #{college}, #{first_intention}, #{second_intention}, #{phone}, #{gender})
INSERT INTO userIp (ip, id) VALUES (#{ip}, #{id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = VALUES (id)

INSERT INTO volunteer (id, volunteer_department, level) VALUES
(#{id}, #{item.departmentId}, #{item.level})

INSERT INTO recruit_user (student_id, user_name, introduction, major, college, first_intention, second_intention, phone, gender) VALUES (#{student_id}, #{user_name}, #{introduction}, #{major}, #{college}, #{first_intention}, #{second_intention}, #{phone}, #{gender}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_name = VALUES (user_name), introduction = VALUES (introduction), major = VALUES (major), college = VALUES (college), first_intention = VALUES (first_intention), second_intention = VALUES (second_intention), phone = VALUES (phone), gender = VALUES (gender);
insert into status (id, department_id, status) values (#{id}, #{departmentId}, 0) on duplicate key update department_id = values (department_id), status = values (status);
insert into comment (id, comment) values (#{id},#{comment}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE comment = VALUES(comment)
mapper.update: update recruit_user set user_name = #{user_name}, introduction = #{introduction}, major = #{major}, college = #{college}, first_intention = #{first_intention}, second_intention = #{second_intention}, phone = #{phone}, gender = #{gender} where student_id = #{student_id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM recruit_user
SELECT volunteer_department AS departmentId, level FROM volunteer WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT status.id) AS value, department.department_name as type FROM status JOIN department ON status.department_id = department.department_id JOIN recruit_user ON status.id = recruit_user.student_id GROUP BY department.department_name;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT status.id) AS total FROM `status` JOIN recruit_user ON status.id = recruit_user.student_id WHERE department_id IN (SELECT department_id FROM department)
SELECT * FROM recruit_user WHERE student_id IN (SELECT id FROM status WHERE department_id = #{departmentId})

SELECT distinct * FROM recruit_user WHERE (student_id like concat('%', #{key}, '%') OR user_name like concat('%', #{key}, '%') OR major like concat('%', #{key}, '%') OR college like concat('%', #{key}, '%') OR phone like concat('%', #{key}, '%')) And student_id in (select id from status)

SELECT DISTINCT recruit_user.student_id, user_name, message, ReviceMessage.messageId FROM ReviceMessage, recruit_user WHERE recruit_user.student_id IN (SELECT id FROM status WHERE department_id = #{departmentId}) AND recruit_user.student_id = ReviceMessage.id
SELECT status.pk_id AS pkId, status.id, department_name, status.status, MessageStatus FROM status, department WHERE department.department_id = status.department_id AND status.id = #{id}
SELECT volunteer_department, level FROM volunteer WHERE id = #{id} order by level

SELECT recruit_user.*, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT image.url ORDER BY image.url ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS urls, status.status, status.department_id FROM recruit_user LEFT JOIN image ON recruit_user.student_id = image.id LEFT JOIN status ON recruit_user.student_id = status.id GROUP BY recruit_user.student_id, status.status, status.MessageStatus;
select comment from comment where id=#{id}

SELECT recruit_user.*, department.department_name FROM recruit_user JOIN status ON recruit_user.student_id = status.id LEFT JOIN department ON status.department_id = department.department_id WHERE status.department_id = #{departmentId} AND status.status = 1
